notes: IMPORTANT: This event is NOT aligned with InstaLILY's ICP. Graphics Pro Expo focuses on small print shops, sign makers, embroidery businesses, and apparel decorators - not the distribution-heavy, multi-location operations (building materials, industrial parts, commercial equipment distributors) that InstaLILY targets. The 2026 exhibitor list is not yet published (registration opens May 15, 2026). Data compiled from 2023-2025 exhibitor lists and confirmed sponsors. Event scheduled for August 13-15, 2026 (per 2026 schedule) but also shows August 21-23, 2025 for the 2025 edition. Most exhibitors are equipment manufacturers and suppliers to the graphics/printing industry, not potential customers for InstaLILY's AI Teammates platform.
